name: claude-context-system
description: Automated claude.md context file manager for AI assistants - supports Claude Code and GitHub Copilot

scripts.sync: pnpm run plugin:sync && pnpm run copilot:sync
scripts.plugin:template:update: cp shared/templates/*.md claude-context-plugin/templates/ && cp shared/templates/*.md copilot-context-cli/templates/
scripts.plugin:command:update: cp shared/commands/*.md claude-context-plugin/commands/ && cp shared/commands/*.md copilot-context-cli/commands/
scripts.plugin:sync: pnpm run plugin:template:update && pnpm run plugin:command:update
scripts.plugin:reinstall: pnpm run plugin:uninstall && pnpm run plugin:sync && pnpm run plugin:install
scripts.copilot:sync: pnpm run copilot:template:update && pnpm run copilot:command:update
